_comments: The builder's editable tree, declared as owned collections so a delete or a reorder commits
as ONE transaction instead of a loop of individual Save()/Delete() calls with no rollback.
Issue #103. Before this, a refusal partway through left a section two-thirds deleted, or a
question live with some of its options gone, with the builder still rendering the rows.
Source/ReadOnly are stated explicitly rather than left to default, following MJ core's one
writable collection (MJ: AI Agents -> Prompts): in a file of cache-backed read-only
projections, an implicit writable one reads as an oversight.
Sequence.From is 0, NOT the default 1: every DisplayOrder already stored is zero-based, and
From: 1 would mark every page, question and option in every form dirty on the first reorder
RelatedEntity and RelatedEntityJoinField are deliberately absent from the JSON — they are
read from this row's own columns (per the column's own description). The lookup below
carries RelatedEntityJoinField because MJ_BizApps_Forms: Forms has relationships to BOTH
Form Pages and Form Questions on FormID, and the join field is what keeps them apart.

primaryKey.ID: @lookup:MJ: Entity Relationships.EntityID=@lookup:MJ: Entities.Name=MJ_BizApps_Forms: Forms&RelatedEntityID=@lookup:MJ: Entities.Name=MJ_BizApps_Forms: Form Pages&RelatedEntityJoinField=FormID

_comments: Joined on PageID, not FormID. FormQuestion carries BOTH keys, and MJ metadata has a
'Forms -> Form Questions' relationship on FormID as well — declaring the collection there
would put every question in the form on every page.

primaryKey.ID: @lookup:MJ: Entity Relationships.EntityID=@lookup:MJ: Entities.Name=MJ_BizApps_Forms: Form Pages&RelatedEntityID=@lookup:MJ: Entities.Name=MJ_BizApps_Forms: Form Questions&RelatedEntityJoinField=PageID

@lookup:MJ: Entity Relationships.EntityID=@lookup:MJ: Entities.Name=MJ_BizApps_Forms: Form Questions&RelatedEntityID=@lookup:MJ: Entities.Name=MJ_BizApps_Forms: Form Question Options&RelatedEntityJoinField=QuestionID
